blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY — A 15-year-old child in conflict with the law (CICL) was formally charged with parricide for the killing of the minor’s 46-year-old mother in Panglao, Bohol, police said. Police Capt. Kentbel Ceasar Parcon, chief of the Panglao Municipal Police Station, said authorities filed the parricide charge, noting that they handled the case in accordance with existing laws. They have placed the minor in the custody of the Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO) pending further court orders, said Chertniel Nuda, an MSWDO officer.
